summary: Tested 11 new feature enhancements from PDF document on F-FDTL Disciplinary Management System. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass (login regression, overdue-em-processo endpoint, member-history cumulative sanctions, toggle-active flow with login block, user creation with new fields, cases unidade filter, dashboard stats). Frontend: All UI elements verified across Users, Cases, UserForm, NotificationBell, Layout pages.

features_verified.P1_overdue_em_processo: PASS - GET /api/notifications/overdue-em-processo returns {notifications, count} with dias_em_processo>30. Accessible to admin AND pessoal_justica. NotificationBell shows tab-atraso (data-testid='tab-atraso') visible and clickable for both roles.
features_verified.P2_3_mandatory_pdf: VERIFIED via code review - CaseDetail.js submitProcess requires processPdfFile, submitStatusChange requires despachoFile for arquivar. Labels updated to 'Anexar Despacho (PDF) *'. Not exercised live (would require full case workflow).
features_verified.P4_user_foto_sidebar: PASS - Layout.js (lines 104-110) conditionally renders when user.foto_url exists, else User icon. /api/auth/me returns foto_url field. Code path correct.
features_verified.P5_cumulative_sanctions: PASS - GET /api/member-history/{nim} returns summary.total_anos_pena (int) and summary.penas_detalhes (array with caso_numero/tipo_sancao/anos). Test asserts sum(penas_detalhes.anos) == total_anos_pena.
features_verified.P6_justica_notif_tabs: PASS - Logged in as justica@falintil.tl: tab-sancoes, tab-apresentacao, tab-atraso ALL visible (was admin-only previously).
features_verified.P7_toggle_active: PASS - PUT /api/users/{id}/toggle-active returns {message, ativo}. After deactivation, login returns 403 'Conta desativada'. After reactivation, login works again. Cannot toggle super_admin (400). UI shows Ativo/Desativado badge + UserX/UserPlus toggle button (data-testid='toggle-user-{id}').
features_verified.P8_9_user_form_new_fields: PASS - UserForm has data-testid='user-nim-input', 'user-sexo-select', 'user-posto-select', 'user-unidade-select'. NIM input filters non-digits ('ABC123XYZ' -> '123'). Backend UserCreate/Update/Response include nim, sexo, posto, componente_unidade, ativo.
features_verified.P10_cases_unidade_filter: PASS - Cases page has data-testid='case-filter-unidade' dropdown. Backend GET /api/cases?unidade={x} filters correctly.
features_verified.P11_users_posto_componente_cols: PASS - Users table headers include Posto, Componente, Status. 3 toggle-user buttons rendered (one per non-super-admin user).
features_verified.regression_login_dashboard_cases: PASS - Login OK; dashboard/stats returns total/pendentes/em_processo/processados/arquivados/anulados; cases list works.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/auth/login response is flat (no nested 'user' object). Frontend AuthContext likely treats whole response as user. This is consistent but worth documenting.

Pre-existing (not from this iteration): /api/cases POST uses count_documents()+1 for numero generation - non-atomic, can cause DuplicateKeyError if cases deleted. Recommend max(numero)+1 aggregation or counters collection.
UserForm NIM input correctly strips non-digits in onChange - good UX. Sexo accepts only M/F via Select - good.
Layout.js correctly handles foto_url with fallback to User icon. filesApi.getUrl resolves S3/MinIO presigned URL.
toggle-active endpoint correctly blocks toggling super_admin (400). Login endpoint correctly checks ativo flag (line 324) and returns 403 with 'Conta desativada'.
member-history cumulative sanctions logic uses hardcoded sancao_duracao mapping - if new sanction types are added, dictionary must be updated. Consider moving to config or DB-driven mapping.
test_credentials: Used superadmin@falintil.tl / Admin@2024 and justica@falintil.tl / Demo@2024 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 1 temporary user per test_toggle_active_blocks_login (TEST_ prefix). Test toggles preserved super_admin protection.

Points 1, 4-11 confirmed live in UI + backend.
